notes: «قال قلت لأبي سعيد» makes Iyad the asker (already in the chain) and Abu Sa'id the one asked, who answers with the Prophet's words: the last link
«يعني ابن هلال» is a gloss and is left out
Tirmidhi's remarks («وفي الباب عن عثمان ...» and «وقد روي عن النبي ... ») name no chain for the second saying and are left out
